source_quotes.exposure: Moderate – for example, sheltered from heavy and wind driven rain and against freezing, whilst saturated with water; buried concrete in soil and concrete continuously under water.
source_quotes.concrete_type: Plain cement concrete shall be used in levelling courses under foundations, floors, copings etc.
source_quotes.mixing_time_minutes: The mixer shall be run for a minimum period of 2 minutes after all materials are loaded in full quantity.
source_quotes.compaction_method: The Contractor shall provide concrete batch mixers, vibrators, weight batches conforming to relevant IS specification.
source_quotes.water_chlorides_mg_l: Chlorides (as C1) 2000 mg/l for plain concrete work and 1000 mg/l for reinforced concrete work
